jobs.title: Manager, Marketing & Communications - Simon Youth Foundation
jobs.description:
Job Location:
Corporate Indianapolis

Position Summary The Marketing & Communications Manager is responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive marketing, communications, and public relations strategies that strengthen Simon Youth Foundation's (SYF) brand, increase community awareness, support fundraising efforts, and highlight the impact of SYF nationally. This position plays a critical role in telling the organization's story, engaging stakeholders, and ensuring consistent messaging across all communication channels.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented creative storyteller, strategic thinker, and collaborative professional who is passionate about advancing opportunities and positive outcomes for students and educators.  The position requires someone who can move comfortably between planning and production while keeping the Foundation's broader brand and audience objectives at the center of the work.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Marketing - Develop and execute annual marketing and communications plans aligned with organizational goals.
- Build brand awareness and promote the Foundation's mission, programs, events, and impact.
- Create and manage marketing campaigns that support fundraising, volunteer recruitment, community engagement, and program participation.
- Monitor marketing performance metrics and provide regular reports and recommendations.
- Ensure brand consistency across all marketing materials and communications.

Brand Stewardship
- Apply SYF's brand standards, messaging guidance, terminology, and approval procedures across public-facing communications.
- Ensure that programs, events, and campaigns remain clearly connected to the Simon Youth Foundation parent brand.
- Review routine materials for visual and message consistency and elevate higher-risk or high visibility items for leadership approval.
- Maintain current templates, shared brand resources, and final approved assets.
- Help staff and partners use brand resources correctly and answer routine brand questions.

Communications
- Develop and implement internal and external communication strategies.
- Create engaging content for newsletters, annual reports, website updates, donor communications, and program materials.
- Write and edit press releases, media advisories, speeches, fact sheets, and organizational messaging.
- Manage media relations and serve as a primary contact for media inquiries.
- Coordinate storytelling initiatives that showcase student and educator success stories, program outcomes, donor impact, and community partnerships.
- Develop communication plans for major organizational announcements and events.

Digital Marketing & Social Media
- Manage the Foundation's website and digital presence.
- Create and maintain a social media content calendar.
- Produce engaging social media content including graphics, videos, photography, and written posts.
- Monitor social media engagement and respond to inquiries in a timely manner.
- Utilize marketing platforms to execute targeted communication campaigns.
- Analyze digital marketing metrics and adjust strategies to improve engagement and reach.

Fundraising & Advancement Support
- Partner with the Advancement team to create marketing materials that support fundraising campaigns and donor stewardship.
- Develop compelling donor impact stories and campaign messaging.
- Assist with sponsorship presentations, grant support materials, and event promotions.
- Support all giving campaigns and community fundraising initiatives.

Community & Stakeholder Engagement
- Collaborate with Program Services to promote partnerships with academies, community organizations, businesses, and youth-serving agencies.
- Represent the Foundation at community events and networking opportunities.
- Help cultivate relationships with donors, volunteers, alumni, and community partners through strategic communications.
- Coordinate outreach efforts that increase awareness of youth programs and services.

Event Marketing
- Develop marketing and communication plans for fundraising events, programs, community and donor outreach activities, and special events.
- Coordinate event promotion through digital, print, media, and community channels.
- Create event materials including invitations, programs, signage, presentations, and post-event communications.

Leadership & Organizational Strategy
- Serve as the Foundation's communications leader, ensuring all messaging consistently reflects the organization's mission, vision, values, and strategic priorities.
- Advise the Vice President, Advancement, President and senior leadership team on communications, public relations, reputation management, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
- Participate in organizational strategic planning and contribute marketing and communications expertise to advance Foundation goals.
- Lead the development and approved execution of crisis communication plans and serve as a key communications resource during sensitive or high-profile situations.
- Build strong relationships with organizational leaders, board members, community partners, donors, and external stakeholders.
- Provide communications support and coaching to Foundation leadership, including speechwriting, presentation development, and media preparation.
- Oversee external consultants, agencies, freelancers, and vendors as needed.
- With the Vice President, Advancement, develop and manage the annual marketing and communications budget.
- Leads by example, reinforcing organizational values and fostering a culture of trust, storytelling, transparency, and mission-centered communication throughout the organization with shared ownership and continuous improvement.
- Identify emerging trends, technologies, and best practices to enhance the Foundation's visibility, engagement, and impact.
- Removes barriers and secures resources needed for success, advocating for staff and marketing and communications priorities at the leadership level.
- Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Nonprofit Management, or a related field.

Experience
- 3-5 years of progressive experience in marketing, content, communications, public relations, or nonprofit marketing.
- Demonstrated ability in developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Experience managing social media platforms and website content.
- Experience editing short-form video and preparing platform-appropriate visual content.
- Experience writing for diverse audiences, including donors, funders, community partners, and families.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in a nonprofit, foundation, education, youth development, or community-based organization.
- Experience supporting fundraising and donor engagement initiatives.
- Graphic design and video production experience.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and marketing platforms such as Canva, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, WordPress, or similar tools
- Familiarity with Google Analytics, campaign tracking, digital analytics, and basic conversion reporting.
- Experience coordinating freelancers, agencies, or creative vendors.
- Basic photography and videography skills, comfort directing simple on-site content capture.

Knowledge, Skills, Leadership and Abilities
- Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
- Strong storytelling and content development abilities.
- Knowledge of digital marketing, social media management, email marketing, and website administration.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage a recurring production schedule with multiple contributors.
- Ability to analyze data and use insights to improve marketing effectiveness.
- Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, youth and educators.
- Sound judgment when working with student stories, photographs, organizational data, and sensitive information.

Reporting Relationship
- The Marketing & Communications Manager reports directly to the Vice President, Advancement

jobs.title: Assistant Operations Director
jobs.description:
Job Location:
Orlando Vineland Premium Outlets

The successful candidate’s responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:
- Assists with the development of a 5-year capital plan to continue to maintain and enhance the property assets and execute against projected capital plans
- Ensures property safety systems are up to code, maintained and inspected
- Conducts daily walk-through’s of the property to ensure physical assets are in best possible operating condition. Respond rapidly to any operational issues uncovered in property inspections
- Assists in the management of procurement and application of all goods and services within annual CAM and Capital Expenditure budget
- Partners with the Operations Director to manage Property Operating expenses within or below budget levels. Effectively manage negative financial variances to overcome or minimize loss within Property Operating budget
- Become comfortable with the work process for both capital projects and ongoing services – including developing scope of work, request for proposal, evaluating contractor submissions/bids, developing service agreements, overseeing contracted work, work inspections, assuring project is completed in accordance with terms of service agreement and required documentation is delivered prior to project close-out and/or payment
- Monitors cleaning services provided through contracts that require rigorous oversight.
- Manages preventive and predictive maintenance, repair, and construction work to sustain safe and reliable operation
- Reads and interprets paper- or computer-based engineering drawings and schematic diagrams
- Works with OD and other maintenance staff members to ensure proper Preventative Maintenance and related record keeping and logs
- Maintains a safe environment and identifies and eliminates safety hazards to Mall staff, tenants and customers. This may include administration of and training for programs such as OSHA, ADA, EPA and other regulated programs
- Works with security and local officials to plan and oversee a fire safety program.
- Supports preparation for emergency and disaster response
- Performs Condition Assessments (either personally or with the assistance of consultants) to assist in development of long range capital plans and budgets.
- Oversees contractors performing capital work
- Interacts with Portfolio Director of Operations and Energy Services
- Provide support to tenants under construction and ensure construction activities match approved plans and comply with mall criteria
- May assist tenants in overcoming Government and permit obstacles, build relationships with key Government officials
- Coordinate and communicate with tenant coordination to insure tenants opens at or before the budgeted RCD
- Develop staff members by enhancing their roles and broadening their experiences.
- Give recognition for good performance and effectively counsel poor performance.
- Complete performance reviews with thorough and objective feedback
- Resolve tenant lease and non-lease concerns related to facility operations
- Establish strong relationships and may frequently interact with key civic leaders (Code Officials, Fire Safety, etc.)
- Maintain good relationships with tenants through frequent interaction, effective follow-through, and by participating in formalized tenant meeting to promote/discuss facility operations initiatives
- Fulfill Manager-on-Duty rotation and manage day to day activities as necessary which may include emergency situations
- Manage operations purchasing program and asset inventory
- Ensure all Services Agreements are current and compliant to the Simon Field Purchasing Policy
- Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor’s degree in related field
- Minimum three years of experience in facility/maintenance operations
- Ability to read and understand blue prints, CAD drawings and other schematics
- Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
- Proficient in the use of computers and programs such as Microsoft Office and other programs as applicable to the property
- Ability to be flexible, prioritize and manage multiple projects, as well as solve problems in a timely manner
- Valid Driver’s License
- Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

jobs.title: Director, Operations-III
jobs.description:
Job Location:
Tyrone Square

PRIMARY PURPOSE:

The Operations Director Center is responsible for maximizing the customers shopping experience and tenant sales by ensuring a clean, well maintained, safe, and friendly and aesthetically pleasing environment, and asset preservation and enhancement while ensuring implementation of all Simon standards. The Operations Director will oversee all operational functions, projects, construction, and contracted services at the center among other things. Therefore, the Operations Director oversees the onsite maintenance, grounds keeping and custodial teams.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
The successful candidate’s responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:
- Develop 5-year capital plan to continue to maintain and enhance the property assets and execute against projected capital plans

- Oversees Preventative Maintenance of equipment and record keeping/related logs

- Ensures property safety systems are up to code, maintained and inspected

- Conduct daily walk-through’s of the property to ensure physical assets are in best possible operating condition. Respond rapidly to any operational issues uncovered in property inspections

- Assist in the management of procurement and application of all goods and services within annual CAM and Capital Expenditure budget

- Manage Property Operating expenses within or below budget levels. Effectively manage negative financial variances to overcome or minimize loss within Property Operating budget

- Conduct regular property inspections and assess the physical assets of the property. Prioritize capital projects to reflect critical needs and affordability

- Manage the work process for both capital projects and ongoing services – including developing scope of work, request for proposal, evaluating contractor submissions/bids, developing service agreements, overseeing contracted work, work inspections, assuring project is completed in accordance with terms of service agreement and required documentation is delivered prior to project close-out and/or payment

- Manage preventative maintenance program and oversee any necessary repair or construction work to sustain a safe and reliable environment

- Manage relationships with third party contracted services providers and ensure adherence to Simon’s Purchasing Policy and Code of Business Conduct

- Co-manage Construction activities with the corporate Development team

- Maintain a safe environment through identification and elimination of any safely hazards to staff, tenants and customers. This includes the administration of all training and regulatory programs (OSHA, ADA, EPA etc)

- Lead maintenance staff in work assignments and training. Assist in maintenance staff performance reviews

- Ensure public safety, Center security and effective risk management

- Read and interpret engineering drawings and schematic diagrams

- Assist General Manager with maximizing margin of profit centers

- Performs Condition Assessments (either personally or with the assistance of consultants) to develop basis for long range capital plans and budgets

- Ensure information contained within the capital database is accurate, current and updated on a real time basis as changes occur

- Complete timely review and processing of vendor invoices, to ensure accurate services were provided prior to payment

- Knowledge of leases in order to determine financial responsibility of operational issues.

- Implement the energy plan communicated by General Manager for to minimize costs while maintaining a comfortable and safe shopping experience

- Prepare and oversee operational budgets and ensure all costs associated with property operations are managed with direct guidance and oversight

- Provide leadership and guidance to the Center staff in the area of operations and customer service as necessary

- Fulfill Manager-on-Duty rotation and manage day-to-day activities as necessary.

- Provide operations support as necessary for special events and holidays

- Contribute to the preparation and annual update of the Center’s five year strategic plan

- Complete required weekly, monthly and quarterly reports

- Assist the General Manager in the management of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan.  Ensure all personnel are trained to function as an Emergency Task Force in Crisis Management response

- Oversee operations in a crisis situation ensuring the safety and security of all customers, tenants, guest and assets

- Resolve escalated customer complaints

- Work with security and local officials to plan and oversee a fire safety program.

- Establish strong relationships and may frequently interact with key civic leaders (Code Officials, Fire Safety, etc.)

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

- Minimum 5 years of prior Operations, Facilities or Property Management experience

- Working knowledge of maintenance and operational functions strongly preferred

- Ability to read and understand blueprints, CAD drawings and other schematics

- Meets commitments - produces accurate work

- Solution oriented and results driven

- Basic to moderate computer skills (email, excel, word, online order systems etc.)

- Valid Driver’s License

- Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development-Simon Media & Experiences
jobs.description:
Job Location:
The Westchester

About Simon Media & Experiences
Simon Media & Experiences is the commerce media, advertising, and experiential marketing business of Simon Property Group. Through Simon's portfolio of premier destinations, Simon Media & Experiences helps brands connect with consumers through audience, media, and experiential solutions designed to drive measurable business outcomes.

At the center of this ecosystem is Simon Media Network (SMN), Simon's commerce media platform. Powered by 200+ destinations, 1.2B annual visits, and first-party behavioral data, SMN enables advertisers to connect with high-value consumers through audience activation, on-property digital out-of-home advertising, and off-platform media channels.

By combining audience intelligence, media activation, and real-world measurement, SMN helps brands reach consumers throughout the path to purchase while delivering measurable business results beyond traditional media metrics.

The Role
We are seeking a Vice President to drive new business across priority non-endemic categories, including CPG, Financial Services, Travel, Auto, and other high-growth sectors. This hands-on sales role will be accountable for developing advertiser and agency relationships, building a strong pipeline, and closing significant new revenue through Simon Media Network, as well as Simon's on-property media portfolio, including digital out-of-home advertising.

Leveraging Simon Media Network as a differentiated entry point, this individual will introduce advertisers to Simon's audience, activation, measurement, and media capabilities while developing solutions that may include audience-led activation, off-platform media, on-site DOOH advertising, and integrated media programs.

The ideal candidate is a proven senior seller who can create a market, not simply manage an existing book of business. This individual brings deep relationships, strong commercial judgment, and a relentless focus on prospecting, advancing opportunities, and closing significant new business.

What You'll Do
·       Develop and execute the go-to-market strategy for priority non-endemic categories while building and leading a small team focused on driving growth and new business development.
·       Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and CRM reporting across non-endemic opportunities.
·       Develop senior-level relationships with brand leaders, agencies, media investment teams, and strategic partners.
·       Develop compelling sales solutions using Simon Media Network and Simon's on-property media portfolio, including digital out-of-home advertising.
·       Personally lead high-value opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation and close.
·       Build and manage a robust pipeline of new national partnerships while ensuring forecasting accuracy and consistent CRM discipline.
·       Partner with Commerce Media, Client Success, Marketing, Insights, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to develop compelling proposals and execute programs.
·       Identify new sales opportunities that expand Simon's relevance with non-endemic brands.
·       Represent Simon Media & Experiences in executive client meetings, industry events, and marketplace engagements.
·       Provide market intelligence and advertiser feedback to inform product development, sales strategy, investment priorities, and the broader growth roadmap.

What You Bring
·       12+ years of experience in advertising, media, retail media, digital, experiential, strategic partnerships, or related revenue-generating environments.
·       Demonstrated success building new categories, developing markets, and generating material revenue from the ground up.
·       Experience leading sales efforts and coordinating resources around complex opportunities.
·       Established relationships with senior marketing executives, agencies, and decision-makers across non-endemic categories, with particular relevance to CPG, Financial Services, Travel, and Auto.
·       A consistent track record of structuring, negotiating, and closing complex, high-value partnerships.
·       Strong understanding of modern media planning, audience targeting, activation, measurement, and integrated advertising solutions.
·       Ability to translate complex capabilities into clear, differentiated business value for executive audiences.
·       Executive presence, commercial judgment, and strong presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
·       Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to create structure, move quickly, and succeed in a fast-growing and evolving business.

Why This Role
Simon Media Network represents a significant growth opportunity within one of the country's most valuable consumer ecosystems. This role offers the opportunity to build new advertiser relationships and drive meaningful growth across priority non-endemic categories.

Success will be defined by the ability to develop executive-level advertiser relationships, build a strong pipeline, and close significant new business across Simon Media Network and Simon's media portfolio.

The salary range for this position is $180,000.00 -$220,000.00.   Actual compensation within that range will be dependent upon various factors, including an individual’s skills, experience and qualifications and the geographic location of the job.  It is uncommon for an individual to be hired at the top end of the pay range

jobs.title: Director of Operations | Retail Property Management (Director, Operations-III)
jobs.description:
Job Location:
Pocono Premium Outlets

Position Overview
Simon is seeking an experienced Director of Operations to oversee all aspects of property operations for one of our premier retail destinations. This leadership role is responsible for maintaining a safe, efficient, and customer-focused environment while protecting and enhancing the value of the asset.

The Director of Operations will lead all operational functions, including facilities management, maintenance, capital projects, vendor management, life safety systems, sustainability initiatives, and operational budgeting. This individual will partner closely with property leadership, tenants, contractors, and corporate teams to ensure an exceptional experience for shoppers, retailers, and stakeholders.

What You'll Do
- Lead day-to-day property operations, maintenance, and facility management activities.
- Develop and manage operating and capital budgets while identifying efficiencies and cost-saving opportunities.
- Oversee building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire and life safety systems.
- Manage capital improvement projects from planning through execution.
- Direct third-party service providers and contractors to ensure quality, service, and compliance standards are met.
- Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, including OSHA and environmental requirements.
- Partner with property management, security, housekeeping, and leasing teams to support business objectives.
- Drive sustainability and energy management initiatives.
- Maintain emergency preparedness and business continuity plans.
- Support tenant openings, renovations, relocations, and redevelopment activities.

What We're Looking For
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, Business, or related field preferred.
- 7+ years of experience in property operations, facilities management, commercial real estate, retail, hospitality, or a related industry.
- Experience managing operating budgets, capital projects, and vendor relationships.
- Strong knowledge of building systems, preventative maintenance programs, and life safety requirements.
- Proven ability to lead teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
- Excellent project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience within retail, shopping centers, mixed-use developments, commercial real estate, or hospitality environments preferred.

Why Join Simon
As the largest owner, developer, and manager of premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and mixed-use destinations, Simon offers the opportunity to impact high-profile properties while working alongside industry-leading professionals. You'll play a critical role in creating world-class experiences for millions of visitors each year.
